reviews.author: Radhe Krishna Shaw
reviews.originalText:
The temple is truly one of the most breathtaking landmarks in Penang and a must visit destination for anyone exploring the island. As one of the largest and most important Buddhist temples in Southeast Asia, it offers a remarkable blend of spirituality, culture, history, and stunning architecture.From the moment you enter the temple complex, you are greeted by beautifully decorated prayer halls, intricate carvings, colorful pagodas, and peaceful gardens. Every corner showcases impressive craftsmanship and centuries of cultural heritage. The iconic Pagoda of Ten Thousand Buddhas and the towering statue of the Goddess of Mercy, Guan Yin, are particularly magnificent and worth the visit alone.What impressed me most was the serene atmosphere despite the popularity of the site. Walking through the temple grounds felt peaceful and calming, allowing plenty of time for reflection while appreciating the beautiful surroundings. The elevated location also offers spectacular panoramic views of Penang, making it a fantastic spot for photography.

The temple is well maintained, and there is plenty to explore, so allow enough time to fully experience the complex. Whether you are interested in religion, architecture, history, or simply looking for one of Penang’s most iconic attractions, Kek Lok Si Temple delivers an unforgettable experience.

A truly inspiring and beautiful place that should not be missed when visiting Penang.

reviews.author: Chng Zi Long
reviews.originalText:
One of the most famous spots in Penang. It has been renovated extensively, with many new buildings added since I was young. The temple's signature feature is the massive Guan Yin statue, which is roughly 30 meters tall.

​In addition to the main statue, there are many other deities and intricate carvings inside the temple, and it takes quite a while to explore them all. Even though I was just roaming around and sightseeing, I easily spent about two hours there. My favorite part was the large, gorgeous mural (or wall carvings) on the upper level of one of the temple buildings.

​Since the temple is built on a mountainside, you can also get a fantastic view of Penang city, making it a perfect spot for photography.

reviews.author: R B
reviews.originalText:
Fantastic! The temple is free but on many levels so you need to purchase a train ticket to access the levels (only 3min rides between levels)
You also need a funicular railway ticket as you can do both Kek Lok Si and Penang Hill (The Habitat) on the same day.

This place was impressive, from the gorgeous Rivendel-style 'turtle temple' to the huge statue which was the crowning glory at the top. You can buy leaves for 2 MYR to feed the turtles (great fun!)
So much to admire including the views from each level 😍

You need about 4 hours max, including browsing the amazing souvenir shops for cheap local handicrafts.

Highly recommend the vegetarian restaurant here. The food was authentic and exceptional 😋

reviews.author: G&Ts World
reviews.originalText:
Kek Lok Si Temple is one of Penang’s most impressive cultural attractions and an experience that should not be rushed.

The temple complex is much larger than we expected, with beautifully detailed architecture, colourful prayer halls, landscaped gardens, statues and peaceful spaces to explore. Every level revealed something different, and the elevated location provided impressive views across Air Itam and George Town.

The towering bronze statue of the Goddess of Mercy, Kuan Yin, is an extraordinary sight, while the Pagoda of Ten Thousand Buddhas was another highlight. The combination of Chinese, Thai and Burmese architectural influences makes the temple unique and provides plenty of opportunities for photography and quiet reflection.

Entry to much of the complex is free, although small fees apply to access some areas and use the lifts. Allow at least two to three hours if you want to explore properly rather than simply visit the main viewpoints.

The temple involves stairs, slopes and walking between different levels, so comfortable footwear is recommended. Dress respectfully, carry water and visit earlier in the day if you want to avoid some of the heat and larger crowds.

A beautiful and culturally significant place that showcases Penang’s history, spirituality and architectural diversity. One of the highlights of our time in Penang and an essential addition to any itinerary.

Greg&Trina.

reviews.author: Sercan Çelik
reviews.originalText:
Kek Lok Si Temple is one of the most impressive and beautiful temples in Malaysia and is undoubtedly one of the highlights of visiting Penang. As the largest Buddhist temple in the country, it combines stunning architecture, peaceful gardens, and breathtaking views over George Town.

The temple complex is enormous, with countless halls, prayer areas, pagodas, and beautifully decorated buildings to explore. One of the main highlights is the magnificent Pagoda of Ten Thousand Buddhas, which blends Chinese, Thai, and Burmese architectural styles. The towering statue of the Goddess of Mercy (Kuan Yin) is equally impressive and offers spectacular panoramic views of the surrounding area.

Walking through the temple is a peaceful experience. The colorful lanterns, intricate carvings, and beautifully maintained gardens create a calm and spiritual atmosphere. Every corner reveals something new, making it easy to spend several hours exploring the complex.

The temple is also an excellent place for photography, especially in the early morning or late afternoon when the lighting enhances the beauty of the buildings. Despite being a popular attraction, the large grounds ensure there are many quiet spots to appreciate the scenery.

Overall, Kek Lok Si Temple is an absolute must-visit in Penang. Whether you're interested in history, architecture, Buddhism, or simply looking for one of the island's most beautiful landmarks, this temple offers an unforgettable experience and is well worth the visit.

reviews.author: Nyonya Kacak
reviews.originalText:
⭐️BOH Tea Centre Sungei Palas is one of the must-visit attractions in Cameron Highlands, especially if you’re a tea lover or simply enjoy beautiful scenery.

😌I visited during a public holiday, so traffic leading to the tea centre was quite heavy. However, once I arrived, the experience was well worth the journey. Visitors can tour the tea factory and learn about the tea-making process, with the staff providing an informative and engaging explanation throughout the tour.

👍🏻After the factory visit, you can relax at the café while enjoying a freshly brewed cup of BOH tea overlooking the stunning tea plantation. The scenery is peaceful and makes for a memorable experience.

🔥My recommendation is to visit early in the morning. Not only will you avoid the larger crowds, but you’ll also enjoy cooler weather and have a more relaxing visit.

✅Overall, it’s a great place to experience the history of Malaysian tea while taking in the beautiful highland landscape. I would happily visit again.

I regularly share my travel experiences, hiking adventures, and destination reviews on TikTok & YouTube (@Nyonya Kacak) for anyone who enjoys exploring Malaysia and beyond.

reviews.author: Dato' Paduka Panji Utara
reviews.originalText:
Experience at BOH Sungai Palas Tea Centre, Cameron Highlands
Spending time at BOH Sungai Palas Tea Centre with my beloved wife was one of the most memorable moments of our trip to Cameron Highlands. The breathtaking scenery of the endless green tea fields, cool mountain breeze, and peaceful atmosphere made it the perfect place to relax and unwind.
We enjoyed a delicious lunch at the tea restaurant, including a warm bowl of soto, a hot cup of freshly brewed BOH tea, and a delightful strawberry cheesecake. Everything tasted even better while overlooking the beautiful tea plantation.
After our meal, we took a leisurely walk around the tea fields, admired the spectacular views, and captured many beautiful photos together. It was a wonderful experience filled with nature, good food, and precious memories.
A highly recommended destination for anyone visiting Cameron Highlands. We will definitely be back again!

reviews.author: Ahmad Hazmi (ahmadhazmi20)
reviews.originalText:
A truly breathtaking place to visit in the Cameron Highlands. The scenery was absolutely beautiful and relaxing. They also offered a free factory tour, which was very interesting and informative to see how BOH tea is produced.

The shop had a wide variety of teas and products from BOH, perfect for souvenirs or tea lovers. There was also a nice cafe serving many types of tea, along with delicious cakes and snacks. Overall, it was a great experience and definitely worth visiting.

reviews.author: Kesh Nan
reviews.originalText:
I had an amazing experience at Sunway Lagoon and it truly deserves a 5-star rating. This is definitely one of the best theme parks in Malaysia for families, friends, couples, and even solo visitors looking for a fun and exciting day out. The park is huge and offers so many attractions that there is something for everyone to enjoy.

The water park was one of my favourite sections. The slides were thrilling, the wave pool was fun, and the overall environment felt clean and well-maintained. I also enjoyed the amusement park rides, especially the more adventurous ones that gave an adrenaline rush. The wildlife park and scream park added even more variety to the experience, making the whole visit feel complete and worth the ticket price.

What impressed me most was how organised and lively the park was. Despite the large crowd, the staff members were friendly, helpful, and professional. The facilities such as restrooms, lockers, and dining areas were also conveniently located and generally well-kept. There were plenty of food options available, so it was easy to spend the entire day there comfortably.

The atmosphere throughout the park was energetic, vibrant, and full of excitement. Every corner had something interesting to see or try. It is truly a place where unforgettable memories can be created with loved ones. I would highly recommend Sunway Lagoon to both locals and tourists visiting Malaysia. I will definitely visit again in the future.

reviews.author: Khairul Nizam Arifin
reviews.originalText:
Sunway Lagoon is a fantastic destination for families and offers a full day of fun for all ages. This is definitely one of the best theme parks in Malaysia for families, friends, couples, and even solo visitors looking for a fun and exciting day out. I also enjoyed the amusement park rides, especially the more adventurous ones that gave an adrenaline rush. The wildlife park and scream park added even more variety to the experience, making the whole visit feel complete and worth the ticket price.

What impressed me most was how organised and lively the park was. Despite the large crowd, the staff members were friendly, helpful, and professional. The facilities such as restrooms, lockers, and dining areas were also conveniently located and generally well-kept. There were plenty of food options available, so it was easy to spend the entire day there comfortably.

The atmosphere throughout the park was energetic, vibrant, and full of excitement. Every corner had something interesting to see or try. It is truly a place where unforgettable memories can be created with loved ones. I would highly recommend Sunway Lagoon to both locals and tourists visiting Malaysia. I will definitely visit again in the future.

reviews.author: Docs On Vacay
reviews.originalText:
📍Pantai Kemayang, Kelantan
This is perhaps my FAVOURITE beach of all time in Kota Bharu.
The amazing view, the chill vibes with the breeze, and the simple but incredibly delicious food; it was perfect.

This beach is a lagoon surrounded by man-made surf breakers - rocks extending far out to the horizon. We walked on these rocks to the very end. It was most breezy and extremely picturesque.

What I also thoroughly enjoyed was the food! Keropok Lekor, coconut juice, Ais Jagung and the best of all was Maggi Kari served Kelantan-style. The Maggi Kari was so incredible that I actually have cravings for it till today; it had limau nipis, the broth was thicker, and there were more spices.

With my limited time in Kota Bharu, this beach definitely tops my list. Hopefully, I'll be able to visit Kelantan again with Michelle if time permits. 2 days wasn't enough to explore this beautiful place.
